model.name: Dual-status reconcile — one truth (status vs statusChecklist), no Done-ness flip
model.description: A Task unit carries TWO independent status fields — model.status (-> planning checkbox) AND model.statusChecklist (free-text -> task-md '## Status') — which can DISAGREE WITHIN the source (e.g. Task 95: status='In Progress' but statusChecklist all-checked). R37.5 makes a task's status ONE truth WITHOUT flipping its displayed Done-ness (disagreements are surfaced for the honesty audit, never silently reconciled to Done = a status invention). Kept OUT of R37.2 (which regenerates from BOTH fields as-is, INV-C4).
model.tronQuote: > (S37 consistency-by-construction, Tron-auth #76) — architect-surfaced during R37.2 design, PO-approved as a distinct req.

discoverySource.note: Surfaced during R37.2 design; PO approved as distinct S37 reqs, kept OUT of R37.2.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A Task's status is ONE truth: model.status and model.statusChecklist are reconciled (or one derived from the other) so they CANNOT disagree within a unit.

The reconcile MUST NOT flip a task's displayed Done-ness (a status='In Progress' + all-checked checklist is SURFACED for the honesty audit, NOT silently flipped to Done) — no status invention, honors R37.2 INV-C4.

A FAIL-LOUD detector assertStatusConsistent asserts status==deriveStatusEnum(statusChecklist) for EVERY Task and exit 1 LISTING every offender, FLAGGING the dangerous status='Done' && Done-box-UNCHECKED subset as FALSE-DONE priority (the honesty-audit target). Folds into ci:gates. The list IS the owner-resolve worklist (resolution flows checklist->status, never reverse).
The 1 malformed (non-string) statusChecklist found on disk is handled safely: deriveStatusEnum and the detector do NOT crash on it — it is flagged for repair-to-template, not silently mis-derived.
status/statusChecklist disagreements are surfaced to the planner honesty audit (the UNIT is the thing to fix, not the view); ties to the S33-36 honesty correction.

TEST = false-Done BITE (distinct-intent, exercises its own AC): plant status='Done' on a task whose checklist Done-box is [ ] -> assertStatusConsistent MUST exit 1 naming it FALSE-DONE; a task with status==deriveStatusEnum(checklist) -> passes; setting status=deriveStatusEnum on a fresh edit keeps them equal (by-construction, no new drift). Verify Impl.tests[] on disk before flip.

assertStatusConsistent EXTENDED (INV-C5-substep): a checklist with a SUB-STEP checked but its PARENT box UNCHECKED (e.g. '[x] refinement' under '[ ] In Progress') is a DRIFT — the parent MUST be checked once any sub-step is (work has started). The detector flags it as a status-drift offender alongside the existing status!=deriveStatusEnum check.

Each flagged task is reconciled PER-TASK to its TRUE state, evidence-driven: if the sub-work genuinely exists, TICK the parent (the honest advance); if the RAW status over-states with no work behind it, correct the RAW field DOWN — NEVER invent a status, NEVER tick a box for absent work (honors the R37.5 no-Done-flip / no-status-invention law).

Reconciliation writes THROUGH the mutation seam (statusNext -> UnitController.apply): it ticks the checklist, deriveStatusEnum derives the status, lastAdvancedAt is stamped source='seam', and it emits — NEVER a hand-edit (which bypasses the seam the mutation-seam lint enforces, and does not emit). A status-reconcile is exactly the write S37 exists to route.

The 7 measured sub-step/parent drift instances (37.24 + 37.27 = S37, DONE through-seam 7a24682d0; 31.6 / 98 / 184 / 142 / iframe-pinch = 5 pending) are a PHASED sweep: report-only -> strict, with a self-draining COUNT 7->0 as the revisit trigger (auto-flip to strict when the count reaches 0). NOT a one-off edit. Do NOT execute the 5 pending now (they would delay the Tron deploy); the counter drains them over time.

The CLIENT view markers (item + detail current/next) MUST read the DERIVED status (deriveStatusEnum(statusChecklist)), NEVER raw model.status — else the item view contradicts the pin (which derives). Architect: the derived status is the single truth the view surfaces (ties R40.18 view-surface + C4.1 self-heal-on-read). GATE: a view reading raw model.status for a current/next marker -> RED.

assertStatusConsistent CONVERSE (INV-C5-substep-under): a task whose IMPLEMENTATION is SHIPPED (an Impl markerPending=false on its chain) while its 'implementing' sub-step box is UNCHECKED is a DRIFT in the OTHER direction (UNDER-statement) — the board tells Tron nothing is happening while work shipped all day (Tron defect-3 'no visible progress!!!!'). Resolution ticks the COMPLETED sub-step per-evidence: implementing<-shipped Impl, testing<-two-keyed passing Test; NEVER a spec/gate-doc (a spec is not test cases = the 'documented therefore done' inflation we refuse). The checklist can lie in BOTH directions; the detector + sweep catch both. Same phased self-draining treatment.

instances.37.27: S37 DONE (through-seam 7a24682d0, In-Progress-early: refinement genuine, implementing not-started)
instances.37.25: S37 checked-VERIFIED-HONEST (R37.12 refinement genuine, impls markerPending=implementing-queued; NOT a reverse-drift, no change)

driftSweep.policy: phased report-only -> strict, self-draining count 7->0 as trigger; reconcile-per-task-to-truth through-seam, never status-invention. Do-not-execute the 5 pending now (Tron deploy focus).
driftSweep.bothDirections: sub-step-checked=>parent-checked (over) AND Impl-shipped=>implementing-checked (under, Tron defect-3). 37.24 is the under-statement instance: implementing shipped (e3729f51) but implementing box unchecked.

model.templateLimitation: CAPTURE (do-not-build, PO 2026-08-17): the 4-state checklist template (Planned / In Progress[refinement/creating-test-cases/implementing/testing] / QA Review / Done) with BINARY boxes CANNOT express PARTIAL sub-step progress — e.g. 37.24 creating-test-cases is partially started (AC-2 Test f2c48a91 exists + r3724b-pin-value-gate.mjs exists, but the AC-1 slice-1 VALUE gate is incomplete/pending v0.8.99), yet a binary box is [x] or [ ] only, so it MUST understate (leave [ ] with a visible reason) rather than overstate. Recorded so the limitation is known, not rediscovered. Not built now.
